alginate:
Alginate dressing is a medical item used to disinfect wounds and greatly treat bleeding, skin damage, and pain.

It is a spool of unique dressing that helps with most trauma due to cuts and lacerations.
adhesivebandage:
Adhesive bandages are a medical item, typically used to treat smaller injuries.

It is a packet containing several small adhesive dressings that are meant to be applied over small wounds, such as bleeding cuts or punctures.
9mmround: 9mm round is an ammunition type usable by the Pistol and Makeshift rifle.
556round: The 5.56 round is an ammunition type used by the Rifle.
12gauge: 12-Gauge buckshot is an ammunition type used by the Pump-action shotgun.
scubadivinggear: The Advanced scuba diving gear is a utility equipment item that can be worn on the back. It provides a set of boosts while submerged in liquids, making them easier and less dangerous to traverse.
rejuvenationchip: The 0.0.7-Emergency Rejuvenation chip is one of the six body chips needed to craft the M.E.R.C. scarf.
swapchip: The 0.2.9-Mind-Swap chip is one of the six body chips needed to craft the M.E.R.C. scarf.
antibiotics:
The Antibiotics bottle is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of Antibiotics.

Antibiotics is a drug that treats infection and sepsis, but lowers mood slightly.

It is a small purple bottle with a red ring around the middle. It contains antibiotic pills for counteracting infections.
antirad:
Anti-rad bottle is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of Anti-rad.

It is a gray bottle with a yellow radiation symbol on the front. It contains experimental medication for treating radiation sickness.
amiodarone:
The Amiodarone bottle is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of Amiodarone.

It is a small bottle with a heart design on the front. It contains an antiarrhythmic medication that works intravenously, however no syringe is included. When injected, it reduces fibrillation rapidly and causes minor muscle damage in the head, thorax and abdomen.
antidepressants:
The Antidepressants bottle is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 140mL of Antidepressants.

Antidepressants are drugs that affect mood.

It is a bluish-gray bottle with dull branding. It contains antidepressants for treating depression.
animalflesh: Animal flesh is a food item. It is used as part of several cooking recipes.
disinfectant:
The Antiseptic bottle  is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 200mL of antiseptic, a basic disinfectant.

It is a simple spray bottle with a blue nozzle. It contains a generic antiseptic that works decently at counteracting infections.
antisepticmush: Antiseptic mush is a medical item used to disinfect wounds.
antiserum:
The Antiseptic bottle is a medical fluid container that spawns with 200mL of Antiserum (liquid), a drug that treats infection and sepsis, as well as blood loss.

It is a small gray and purple container with an autoinjector on top.
armwarmers:
Arm warmers are an Armor item worn on the arms. They provide some protection and insulation to both arms.

They can be crafted into Ripped dressing.
aquapple: Aquapple is a food item. It can be used to satisfy thirst at the slight cost of Mood.
autoinjector: Auto-injectors are intermediary crafting items used to make more advanced medical gear.
applejuice:
The Apple juice carton is a fluid container item that spawns with 800mL of Apple Juice. It's a green carton with a red stripe across it's middle.

Apple Juice is typically used to satisfy Thirst and increase Mood.
aed:
The Automated External Defibrillator (AED) is a medical device that is capable of diagnosing and treating Fibrillation.

It is powered by either a Small battery or a Medium battery.
bikehelmet:
Bicycle helmet is an Armor item worn on the head. It provides head protection and minor insulation.

It can be crafted into the Riot helmet.
bellyarmor: Belly armor is an Armor item. It provides high abdomen protection and minor insulation.
balaclava: Balaclava is an Armor item worn on the head. It provides head protection and insulation.
autozoomgoggles:
The Auto-zoom goggles are a utility equipment item.

They increases your vision range when worn.
bigpack:
The Backpack is a craftable and wearable storage container. 

It is a very versatile container due to its very high capacity and max weight per item, in addition to good encumbrance reduction and a long lifespan.

The Backpack additionally provides a small amount of insulation.

In emergencies, it can be ripped for 25% of its durability into a Ripped dressing, for up to two full Dressings.
belt:
The Belt is a craftable and wearable storage item that can only hold tools and certain other items. It is invaluable for its easy obtainment, ability to store many common tools efficiently, and extremely long lifespan.

In emergencies, it can be used to craft Ripped dressing.
bandolier:
The Bandolier is a wearable Storage item that can only hold bullets.

It allows the player to carry more items by increasing carrying capacity.
autopump:
The Auto-pump is a wearable medical tool.

While worn, it ensures your blood pressure stays high enough until the Battery runs dry.

It is typically used as a temporary life-support during a critical health crisis.
bloodbag:
Blood bag is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 750 mL of Blood.

It can be used to treat blood loss.
bleach:
The Bleach bottle is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 1500mL of Bleach.

It can be used as an antiseptic for disinfecting wounds or crafting.

It can also be drank, however you should never do that due to its serious negative side effects.
fleshchunk:
Big flesh chunk is a food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger and gain Body mass.
blobflesh:
Blobflesh is a food item, that is gathered from the Leadbush "plant".

It can be used to satiate Hunger, though at the cost of Sickness.

It is also used in recipes for its meat quality.
blindfold:
Blindfold is an Armor item. It provides minor head protection and insulation.

It can be crafted into Ripped dressing.
bloodcrystalshard:
The Blood crystal shard is a Blood-restoring crystal.

While stored in your main Inventory (not in a container), it will restore Blood at a rate of +0.12 L/m.
bloodsac: Blood sac is an item that is usually dropped by enemies upon death. While it can be eaten, it is more useful for crafting Alien blood (liquid).
alcohol:
Bottle of alcohol is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 400mL of Alcohol.

It can be used as an antiseptic for disinfecting wounds or crafting.

It can also be drunk, however this is not recommended as it makes you very sick.
boneweldingtool: The Bone welding tool is a medical item used to speed up the healing of bone fractures at the cost of skin damage, muscle damage, pain and bleeding.
blueprint:
Blueprint is a one-time use utility item that gives 25 INT exp and unlocks a random recipe.

It always drops from Life-pod chests.
braingrow:
Braingrow is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100 mL of Braingrow.

It is typically used to treat Brain damage.
boxof12gauge: Box of 12-Gauge is an ammo container that can be filled with 12-Gauge buckshot.
bread:
Bread is a food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger.
bowlofcereal:
The Bowl of cereal is a craftable fluid container Item that spawns with 500mL of Cereal mix.

It is typically used to satisfy Thirst, satiate Hunger and improve Mood.
browncap: Browncap is a produce item that can be obtained from Brownshrooms. It affects the player with a randomized set of effects when consumed.
cookies:
Box of cookies is a food item.

It satiates Hunger and increases Mood at the cost of Sickness.
bruisekit: Bruise kit is a medical item used to treat skin damage, muscle damage, pain, and dislocations. It does not affect bleeding.
campfire: The Campfire is a physics object that emits light and produces heat. It counts as a heat source for crafting (such as for Refined juice and Burger).
burger:
Burger is a craftable food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger, gain Body mass and increase Mood.
cake:
Cake is a food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger, and gain Body mass as Cake increases it more than any other item when fully consumed. It also grants some Happiness.
bucketofchicken:
Bucket of chicken is a food item that turns into Bucket of no chicken when fully consumed. 

It is typically used to satiate Hunger, gain Body mass and increase Mood.
bunchunk: Bunchunk is a teal fungus with medicinal properties. It induces sickness and sepsis when eaten, but also decreases internal bleeding and increases blood viscosity.
bucketofnochicken:
The Bucket of no chicken is a Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
hardcandy: Candy is a light food item that restores a small amount of hunger and happiness in return for some sickness.
bundleofwires: Bundle of wires is an intermediary crafting item used to make a wide range of tools and electrical items.
cactusflesh: Cactus flesh is a produce item that can be obtained from Cacti in the Dried desert.
carcasssplint:
Carcass splint is a medical item used to speed up the process of healing bone fractures and dislocations.

It is the makeshift counterpart of Splint.
candybar: Candy bar is a light food item that restores a small amount of hunger and mood in return for some sickness.
casing: Casing is an intermediary crafting component used for creating ammunition for firearms.
canteen:
Canteen is a craftable fluid container item that can hold 300mL of liquid.

It is crafted with materials that are easily found on the first layers, making it a good early-game liquid container.
carapace: Carapace is an Armor item. It provides thorax protection and some insulation.
ceftriaxone:
Ceftriaxone syringe is a medical fluid container item that spawns with  100mL of Ceftriaxone.

Ceftriaxone is an antibiotic, typically used to treat Infection and Sepsis.
box:
The Cardboard box is a Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
chestdrain: Chest drain is a medical item used to treat hemothorax.
chocolatebar:
Chocolate bar is a food item.

It can be used to satiate Hunger and improve Mood, though at the cost of major Sickness.
plasticchunk: Chunks of plastic are a crafting material.
charcoal: Charcoal is a craftable item. It can be used as a substitute for wood-based items when creating Campfires.
chocolatemilk:
Chocolate milk bottle is a fluid container item that spawns with 1000mL of Chocolate milk.

It satisfies Thirst and boosts Mood at the cost of causing Sickness.
chips: Chips are a food item that can be obtained from loot or traders.
cereal:
Cereal is a food item.

It can be used to satiate hunger, though at the cost of hydration.

It can also be crafted into Bowls of cereal, which makes it healthier.
combatpen:
The Combat pen is medical fluid container item, that contains 3 powerful performance-enhancing Drugs. 

It is typically used in life-threatening scenarios to aid in combat or enable escape, but it also reduces Fibrillation and has a chance to cure Cardiac arrest.
clottingmush:
Clotting mush is a craftable medical item.

It is used to reduce Bleeding on a limb.

It is also a crafting material.
crudecleaver:
The Crude cleaver is a crafting Tool.

It can also be crafted into the Machete.
claws: The Claw pack is a melee Weapon.
climbingclaws:
The Climbing claws are a utility equipment item.

They are typically used to aid in climbing.
climbingrope: The Climbing rope is an utility item that can be used to climb down safely.
circuitboard: Circuit board is an intermediary crafting material commonly obtained from traps. Low-condition circuit boards can be repaired with wires and used in crafting.
coffee:
The Coffee cup is a fluid container item that spawns with 250mL of Coffee.

Coffee can be used to satisfy Thirst and increase Mood and Energy, though at the cost of Sickness.
bandage: Dressing is a craftable medical item. It treats bleeding, skin damage, pain, and bone injuries.
dogfood:
Dog food is a food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger.
dustmask: Dust mask is an Armor item. It provides minor head protection and insulation.
dryfoliage:
Dried foliage is a Crafting material.

It is primarily used in recipes for its foliage quality, but it can also be eaten.
duffelbag:
The Duffel bag is a craftable and wearable Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.

It also provides a small amount of insulation from the elements.
digestioncrystalshard:
The Digestion crystal shard is a Sickness-reducing crystal.

While stored in your main Inventory (not in a container), Sickness will be decreased by -30/m.

It can be used to craft 200mL of Naltrexone (liquid).
drillrepairkit: Drill repair kit is an utility item that can be used with Drill pods to repair them. The item is consumed upon use.
droppings: Droppings are an item that can be found randomly in the world, and are also created periodically by the player character.
cryogeniccore: The Cryogenic core is an advanced device capable of controlling the temperature around it. It is a one-time use item.
emergencylight: An emergency light is a light-emitting utility item. It is dim and produces a small cone of light.
epda:
The E-PDA is a special item that provides Intelligence experience when used.

It sometimes spawns inside a Life-pod upon world generation.
emissivecrystalshard:
The Emissive crystal shard is a light-emitting crystal.

It produces a very bright light in all directions.
dynamite:
Dynamite is a craftable offensive utility item. Lighting it results in a devastating explosion after a delay.

It is typically used to aid in combat or help break into sealed Structures.
watch:
The Electronic watch is a utility tool.

It can be used to get more information about your general health.
exposedcore:
The Exposed core is a Food item that drops from the Manifestation and a Certain Crystal, both found in the Crystalline Hollow.

It satisfies Thirst and Hunger, and boosts Energy and Mood. It also provides a temporary buff to Mobility.
energydrink:
The Energy drink can is a fluid container item that spawns with 250mL of Energy drink.

Energy drink can be used to increase Hydration, Energy and Mood, but at the cost of major Sickness.
earmuffs: Earmuffs are a clothing item worn on the head that protect the wearer from loud noises.
fentanyl:
Fentanyl syringe is a medical mixed fluid container item that spawns with 90mL of Water and 10mL of Fentanyl.

As it is an Opiate, Fentanyl can be used to treat Pain. However, being an extremely potent opiate, even small injections can quickly cause overdose.
flashlight: Flashlight is a light source that accepts batteries and can be toggled into different light modes.
flammablepowder: Flammable powder is a crafting material.
flimsyknife: The Flimsy knife is a crafting Tool.
fannypack:
The Fanny pack is a wearable Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
firestarter: Firestarter is a tool that is mainly used to craft Campfires. It can craft up to 3 campfires before being used up completely.
flexiglass: Flexiglass is an intermediary crafting item used to make a wide range of tools and items.
filterstraw: The Filter straw is a utility item that can be used to reduce the harmful effects of liquids when you drink them.
geofruit:
The Geofruit is a food item that can be gathered from Geotrees.

It can be used to increase Hydration, Satiation and Mood.
foliagemeal:
Foliage meal is a food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger.
glowplantfruit:
The Glowplant fruit is a crafting material, Light source, and disinfectant.

It emits a dim light in all directions.
foliagebag:
The Foliage bag is a craftable Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
gravbag:
The Grav-Bag is a Storage item.

It allows you to carry more items by raising your carrying capacity.
grapplinghook:
The Grappling hook is a utility tool.

It can be used to scale cliffs and cross large gaps.
geigercounter: The Geiger counter is a craftable utility tool that warns the player of Radiation.
funguschunk: Fungus chunk is a food item that affects the player with a randomized set of effects when consumed.
frigiantfruit:
The Frigiant fruit is a food item. It can be gathered from the Frigiant plant.

It can be used to satisfy Thirst and Hunger, it also greatly decreases Temperature.
handcrank: Hand crank charger is a utility item that is used to charge batteries.
heroin:
Heroin syringe is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 50mL of Water and 100mL of Heroin.

As an Opiate, Heroin can be used to treat Pain. However, due to the Sickness it causes, it is better used for selling or crafting.
helluce:
Helluce is a dry purple leaf with medicinal properties that can be harvested from the Pop plant.

It treats internal bleeding, sickness, and hearing loss, but increases temperature.
heavydrill: The Heavy drill is a mining Tool.
headlamp:
The Headlamp is a craftable utility equipment item.

It shines a bright cone of light into your looking direction when worn.
holidayhat: Holiday hat is a Clothing item worn on the head. It provides minimal head protection and some insulation.
heatfernsponge:
The Heatfern sponge is a Food item and disinfectant. It can be gathered from the 16px Heatfern plant.

It can be used to satiate Hunger, though this comes at the cost of minor Sepsis.

It can also be used to disinfect wounds, this causes minor Sepsis too.
icepack: The Ice pack is a craftable medical item used to treat muscle damage, pain, and hyperthermia.
saline: IV bag is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 750mL of Saline. When injected, it treats blood loss and thirst.
hoodie: Hoodie is an Armor and Storage Item. It provides protection to the torso, arms, hands and thighs, and significant insulation.
jetpack:
The Jetpack is an utility equipment item and storage container.

It essentially allows you to fly, enabling you to reach high places and slowing your descent when falling.
internalorgans: Internal organs is a food item.
ilmenitechunk: Ilmenite chunk is an ore that can be obtained from mining Ilmenite. It can be further refined into Titanium slabs.
icetea:
The Iced tea bottle is a fluid container item that spawns with 500mL of Iced tea.

Iced tea increases Hydration and Mood at the cost of minor Sickness.
lrd:
L.R.D. is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 75mL of L.R.D. Serum.

It is a very useful item due to its strong positive effects.
It counteracts infections, heals damaged muscles, numbs pain, slows down internal and external bleeding and energizes you.

Its makeshift counterpart is the Makeshift L.R.D.
lantern:
A Lantern is a light-emitting utility item that emits bright light in all directions.

It is the longest lasting non-battery-powered light source.
kneepads: Kneepads are an Armor item. They provide lower leg protection and minimal insulation.
keratinbooster:
Keratin booster is a medical fluid container item that spawns with  100mL of Keratin-booster.

It is typically used to treat Dulled claws.
lcdscreen: LCD screen is an intermediary crafting material used to make items such as the Geiger counter and Terrain scanner.
ketchup:
The Ketchup bottle is a fluid container item that spawns with 300mL of Ketchup.

Ketchup is typically used in crafting for it's condiment quality.

But it can also be used to satisfy Thirst and Hunger, though this comes at the cost of Mood and Sickness.
kineticchip: The Kinetic Transmitter chip is one of the six body chips needed to craft the M.E.R.C. scarf.
lightbulb:
The Lightbulb is a utility item that emits light.

It can be used to craft the Flashlight.
liquidcentrifuge:
Liquid centrifuge is a utility fluid container item that is used to split a mixture of liquids into separate containers.

It recharges every 60 seconds and can only be used when it contains fluid.
limbwraps: Limb wraps are an Armor item. They provide protection to the hands, forearms and feet, and minor insulation.
latexgloves: Latex gloves are a Clothing Item. They provide minor insulation.
largebattery: Large batteries are used to power certain Items.
legpouch:
The Leg pouch is a wearable Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
largecarcass: Large carcass is an intermediary crafting material used to make the Makeshift helmet and Carcass splint.
lighter: Lighter is an improved version of the Firestarter that is mainly used to craft Campfires. It can craft up to 100 campfires before being used up completely.
lemonade:
The Lemonade jar is a fluid container item that spawns with 750mL of Lemonade.

Lemonade can be used to satisfy Thirst and increase Mood.
makeshiftlrd:
The Makeshift L.R.D. is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 50mL of L.R.D. Serum.

It is a very useful item due to its strong positive effects.

It counteracts infections, heals damaged muscles, slows down Internal bleeding and energizes you.

It is the makeshift counterpart of the  L.R.D.
mp3player:
MP3 player is a utility item that can play music.

It is powered by a Small battery.
magazinebase: Magazine base is a crafting material.
machete:
The Machete is a melee Weapon.

It can also be crafted into the Titanium machete.
lockpickingkit: The Lock-picking kit is a tool that can be used to unlock containers faster and in a safer manner than using the player's claws to do it.
liquidpouch:
The Liquid pouch is a wearable fluid container item.

It can be used to store 1000mL of any Fluid.
mercscarf: M.E.R.C. scarf is a wearable clothing item, and the key to the Mercenary ending.
aichip: The MINI-AI chip is one of the six body chips needed to craft the M.E.R.C. scarf.
makeshiftrifle: Makeshift rifle is a firearm that uses 9mm rounds as ammunition, and can be reloaded using Small magazines. It fires a single, inaccurate shot.
manualdefibrillator:
The Manual Defibrillator is an item that can be used to  diagnose and treat Fibrillation, much like the AED, although it is much more complicated to operate.

It is powered by either a Small battery or a Medium battery.
analgesicgauze: Medical Gauze is a medical item used to treat bleeding, skin damage, and pain. It also has an opiate effect.
medicalsuture:
Medical suture is a medical item that treats bleeding and skin damage.

It is suited to heavy injuries, as unlike Dressings, you do not have to wrap them around the limb. However, it causes pain on use.
makeshifthelmet: Makeshift helmet is an Armor item. It provides head protection and minor insulation.
makeshiftdiggingtool:
The Makeshift digging tool is a mining Tool.

The Makeshift digging tool can also be used to craft the Pickaxe.
makeshiftwrench:
The Makeshift wrench is a crafting Tool.

It can also be crafted into the Wrench.
makeshiftheadlamp: Makeshift headlamp is equipment that can be worn on the head. It provides a radial source of light equivalent to a Glowplant fruit.
medkit:
The Med-kit is a Storage item that can only hold medical items.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
materialpouch:
The Material pouch is a craftable and wearable Storage item. It specializes in storing very small items, due to its very low max weight per item and very high encumbrance reduction.

For experienced players, the Material pouch is a must-have for efficiently storing crafting materials.
primitivediggingtool: The Metal digging tool is a mining Tool.
shovel: The Metal shovel is a mining Tool.
pitchfork: The Metal pitchfork is a melee Weapon.
sickle: The Metal sickle is a melee Weapon.
mediumbattery: Medium batteries are used to power certain Items.
milk:
The Milk carton is a fluid container item, that spawns with 1000mL of Milk.

Milk is typically used to increase mood and satisfy thirst, and to a lesser extent also hunger.
capacitorchip: The Micro-SINGLEBTR 1CHRG capacitor is one of the six body chips needed to craft the M.E.R.C. scarf.
minibarrel: The Mini-barrel is a very large fluid container item that can spawn with up to 10,000mL of various liquids inside. It can contain any liquid in the game, and might contain a mixture of up to eight different liquids.
naloxone:
Naloxone syringe is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of Naloxone.

It is one of the two opiate antagonist items in the game, the other being Naltrexone bottle.
morphine:
Morphine syringe is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of Morphine.

Morphine is typically used to treat Pain.
minilaserdrill: The Mini laser drill is a mining Tool.
minifleshrebuilder: The Mini flesh rebuilder is an experimental medical device that uses samples of flesh to heal traumatic injuries to the head.
naltrexone:
Naltrexone bottle is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100 mL of Naltrexone.

It is one of the two opiate antagonist items in the game, the other being Naloxone syringe.

It is typically used to treat opiate abuse and Sickness.
neuralbooster: The Neural booster is a special medical item that grants mobility buffs, restores some Brain health and cures Stroke.
nopopcorn:
No popcorn is a Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
nutrientbar:
Nutrient bar is a food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger.
mushtail:
A Naptail is an herbal medicine item that drops from Hydreeds.

It can be used to forcefully induce sleep and increase Mood.
mushpear:
The Numberry is an off-tasting fruit that is dropped by Hydreed plants. 

It is usually avoided as a Food source due to its negative properties, but it can be used to treat Pain.

It is also craftable into Opium.
nondescriptcan:
The Nondescript can is a food item.

It can be consumed, but it has very random effects.
nanotechscanner: The Nano-tech scanner is a device that detects the body chips needed for the M.E.R.C. scarf, and is the first step towards the Mercenary ending.
rag: Old rag is a medical item that can be used as dressing or to dry yourself.
painkillers:
Painkiller bottle is a fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of Painkillers.

Painkillers is an Opiate, typically used to treat pain.
opium:
Opium syringe is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of Opium.

Opium is typically used to treat Pain.
oxygencrystalshard:
The Oxygen crystal shard is a Stamina-restoring crystal.

While stored in your main Inventory (not in a container), Stamina regeneration is boosted by +2%/s.
peo: The P.E.O. limb (Prosthetic Enhanced Operation limb) is a medical item that can be used to replace missing limbs. It is better than a normal limb in almost every way.
pistol:
The Pistol is a firearm that uses 9mm rounds as ammunition, and can be reloaded using Small magazines. It fires a single shot with high accuracy in semi-auto mode.

With a loaded magazine, shooting the Pistol ejects the spent casing and chambers in a new round.
pizzaslice:
Pizza slice is a food item.

It satiates Hunger and increases Mood.
pancake:
Pancakes is a food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger and increase Mood.
pemmican:
Pemmican is a food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger.
pickaxe:
The Pickaxe is a mining Tool.

The Pickaxe can also be used to craft the Titanium pickaxe.
plasmacutter: The Plasma cutter is a mining Tool.
plasticbag:
The Plastic bag is a Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.

It can also be used to craft Ripped dressing.
paprikash:
Paprikash is a food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger and increase Mood.
peglimb: The Peg limb is an medical item that can be used to replace missing limbs.
plasticbandage: Plastic dressing is a medical item used to treat bleeding, skin damage, pain, and bone injuries.
pouch:
The Pouch is a Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
popcorn:
Popcorn is a Food item.

It is typically used to satiate Hunger and increase Mood.
plushie: Plushies are utility Items that can have a variety of sprites.
processedcopper: Processed copper is an intermediary crafting material.
popfruit:
Popfruit is a produce item that is obtained by breaking Pop plants.

It is typically used to satisfy Hunger and Thirst.
bulbskin:
Popskin is a very versatile natural resource that is gathered from the Pop plant.

It can be used to satisfy thirst, though at the cost of minor brain damage.

It can also be applied to a limb to treat bleeding and pain.
present:
The Present is a special Christmas-themed item.

It can be opened to gain the gifts inside.
shotgun:
The Pump-action shotgun is a firearm that uses 12-Gauge buckshot as ammunition. It fires a spread of projectiles, each of which can independently hit an enemy or structure.

After each shot, the pump-action shotgun has to be manually pumped to eject the previous cartridge and then again to chamber a new one.
bloodbaghuman:
Red blood bag is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 750 mL of Red blood.

It can be used to treat blood loss or inserted into the Bio-terminal to open Reinforced doors.

It is not recommended to inject Red blood into yourself due to its significant side effects. The Red blood can be crafted into something like Saline to remove its side effects and add other uses.
bloodcoagulant:
Procoagulant syringe is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of Procoagulant.

Procoagulant treats Bleeding and Stroke.
rake: The Rake is a mining Tool.
purse:
The Purse is a Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
rangefinder:
The Rangefinder is a utility tool.

It can be used to figure out the depth of drops and height of ceilings.
rawcopper:
Raw copper is a crafting material.

It can be gathered by mining Copper ore tiles.
regenerationchip: The REL-Hyper-Regeneration Booster chip is one of the six body chips needed to craft the M.E.R.C. scarf.
rifle:
The Rifle is a firearm that uses 5.56 rounds as ammunition, and can be reloaded using Rifle magazines. It fires automatically as long as  is held down.

With a loaded magazine, shooting the Rifle ejects the spent casing and chambers in a new round.
paincream:
Relief cream bottle is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of relief cream.

It can be used to reduce Pain and disinfect limbs.
riflemagazine: Rifle magazine is an ammo container that can be filled with 5.56 rounds.
riothelmet: Riot helmet is an Armor item. It provides good head protection and some insulation.
reliefcrystalshard:
The Relief crystal shard is a Pain-reducing crystal.

While stored in your main Inventory (not in a container), all limb Pain decreases at a rate of -20/s.

It can also be used to craft 200mL of Painkillers (liquid).
redfoliage: Red foliage is a plant material found in the Crimson Ascent, dropped by crimson bushes, crimtrees and pus sacks. It can be eaten or used as foliage for crafting.
rippeddressing:
Ripped dressing is a craftable medical item.

It is used to treat bleeding, skin damage, pain, and bone injuries.
safetyglasses: Safety glasses are an Armor item. They provide head protection.
brokenbag:
The Ripped bag is a Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.

It can also be used to craft Ripped dressing.
scaffoldingpack: The Scaffolding pack is a utility item that is used to place Scaffolding tiles.
rope: Rope is a basic crafting material that is crafted from Foliage. It can be used to craft a large variety of starting items.
ryeflour: Rye flour is a cooking ingredient that can be used to craft food items.
rosepod: The Rose pod is a natural resource that can be gathered from the Sand rose plant.
roselight:
The Rose light is an opened Rose pod.

It shines a powerful light in all directions. It can also be used to detect infections early.
ryebulb:
The Rye bulb is a natural resource that is gathered from the File:Ceilingrye.png Ceiling rye plant.

It can be crafted into Rye flour using a hammering tool.
scrappanel: Scrap panel is an intermediary crafting component used for creating various items.
scarf:
Scarf is a craftable Clothing item. It provides insulation.

It can be crafted into Ripped dressing.
sledgehammer: The Sledgehammer is a mining Tool.
sleepingbag:
A Sleeping bag is a utility item. 

It is primarily used to increase sleep quality.
slingbag: The Sling bag is a wearable and craftable Storage item. It is easy to craft early into a run, essentially functioning as a rudimentary Backpack.
scrapmetal:
Scrap metal is a common crafting material found throughout the game. It can be obtained from various tiles and entities.

It is a precursor to many powerful crafting recipes.

It can also be used to place scrap tiles in the world.
scrapcube: Scrap cube is an intermediary crafting material used to craft other scrap-based materials and specific tools.
scraptube: Scrap tube is an intermediary crafting material.
sleepingpills:
Sleeping pills packet is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 25mL of Sleeping pills.

It is typically used to enable Sleep when in Pain, Sickness or  Opiate withdrawal.
ringersolution:
Small IV bag is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 700mL of Ringer's solution.

It can be used to treat blood loss and thirst.
smallmagazine: Small magazine is an ammo container that can be filled with 9mm rounds.
smallbattery: Small batteries are used to power certain Items.
sneakers: Sneakers are an Armor Item. They provide feet protection and minor insulation.
smallpack:
The Small backpack is a wearable Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.

It also provides a very small amount of insulation from the elements.
sodacan:
The Soda can is a fluid container item that spawns with 250mL of Soda.

Soda is typically used to increase Hydration, Energy and Mood but this comes at the cost of Sickness.
sodabottle:
The Soda bottle is a fluid container item that spawns with 1000mL of Soda.

Soda is typically used to increase Hydration, Energy and Mood but this comes at the cost of Sickness.
splint:
The Splint is a medical item used to speed up the process of healing bone fractures and dislocations.

Its makeshift counterpart is the Carcass splint.
steak: Steak is a food item that significantly boosts satiation and mood.
spraybottle:
Spray bottle is a fluid container item that can store 200mL of any liquid.

It can be crafted from Canteen.
sodiumnitroprusside:
Sodium nitroprusside bottle is a fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of Sodium nitroprusside.

Sodium nitroprusside is typically used to lower Blood pressure.
soup: Soup bowl is a fluid container item that spawns with 300mL of Soup.
spacedrain: Space-drain is a utility item that removes liquids around the player on use.
soothingcrystalshard:
The Soothing crystal shard is a Mood-increasing crystal.

While stored in your main Inventory (not in a container), it increases Mood by 2.4 every minute, or 0.04 every second. It can provide a maximum of 48 Mood.

It can be used to craft Antidepressants (liquid).
spicevineleaf: Spiceleaf is a dry stalk with numerous bright leaves, gathered from Spicevines. It can be eaten, used on limbs as an antiseptic, or used as foliage for crafting.
sterilizedbandage: Sterilized dressing is a medical item used to disinfect wounds and treat bleeding, skin damage, pain, and bone injuries.
striderpelt: Strider pelt is an Armor Item. It provides protection to the head, torso and thighs, and significant insulation.
streptokinase:
Streptokinase syringe is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of Streptokinase.

Streptokinase is a Blood thinner, typically used to treat high Blood viscosity and Pulmonary embolism.
carcass: Stiff carcass is a crafting material.
stick: Stick is an intermediary crafting material.
string: String is an intermediate crafting material used to make a wide range of wearables and tools.
stonefruitclosed:
The Stuck stone fruit is a natural resource, that can be gathered from the File:Stoneplant.png Stoneplant.

It can be opened to gain a Stone fruit.
stonefruitopen:
The Stone fruit is a natural resource, that is gained by opening a Stuck stone fruit.

It can be used to satiate Hunger, but this comes at the cost of Thirst.
steelprosthesis: The Steel prosthesis is a medical item that can be used to replace missing limbs. It is equal to a normal limb in most ways.
craftingbottle: Temporary bottle is a fluid container item that can only spawn when a liquid is crafted without any space in an available liquid container to fill. All repeat crafts of a certain liquid add to the same temporary bottle, assuming there is enough space to fit all of it.
syringe: The Syringe is a craftable fluid container item that can hold 100mL of any fluid. It looks like a modified Canteen.
tacticalboots: Tactical boots are an Armor item. They provide good feet protection and decent insulation.
tacticalgloves: Tactical gloves are an Armor item. They provide hand protection and insulation.
titaniumpickaxe: The Titanium pickaxe is a mining Tool.
titaniummachete: The Titanium machete is a melee Weapon.
titaniummultitool: The Titanium multitool is a crafting Tool.
terrainscanner:
The Terrain scanner is a craftable utility tool.

It can be used to gauge the safest path downwards.
titaniumrod: Titanium rod is an intermediary crafting material used to make titanium tools.
titaniumsheet: Titanium sheet is an intermediary crafting material used to make titanium tools and late game items.
torch: The Torch is a utility item that emits light.
tourniquet:
Tourniquet is a medical item that cuts off circulation to a limb, instantly stopping any bleeding and buying time to treat the wound. However, it causes moderate pain to the limb.

Its effectiveness combined with its low weight, cheap cost and re-usability makes it extremely useful.
traumarig:
Trauma rig is an Armor and Container item. It provides abdomen protection.

It can only hold items in the Tool, Weapon, and Medical item categories.
tornshirt: Torn shirt is an Armor Item. It provides protection to the thorax and abdomen, and some insulation.
trowel: The Trowel is a mining Tool.
trashbag:
The Trash bag is a Storage item.

It is typically used to increase carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
turbulentcrystalshard:
The turbulent crystal shard is a mobility-enhancing crystal. 

While stored in your main Inventory (not in a container), it will boost jump height. This effect can be stacked by holding multiple turbulent shards.
toolbox:
Toolbox is a Storage item that can only be held in your hand slots.

It increases carrying capacity, allowing you to take a larger amount of items with you.
titaniumslab: Titanium slab is an intermediary crafting component used to create other titanium items.
tweezers: Tweezers are a medical item used to make pulling out shrapnel much faster and less dangerous.
vasopressin:
Vasopressin bottle is a medical fluid container item that spawns with 100mL of  Vasopressin.

Vasopressin is typically used to raise Blood pressure.
woodsandals: Wood sandals are a craftable Armor Item. They protect the feet from Glass shards.
woodcube: Wood cube is an intermediary crafting material.
woodpanel: Wood panel is an intermediary crafting material.
woodscraps: Wood scraps is an intermediary crafting material.
waterbottle:
The Water bottle is a fluid container item that spawns with 500mL of Clean water.

Clean water is typically used to satisfy thirst.
waterjug:
The Water jug is a fluid container item that spawns with 3000mL of Clean water.

Clean water is typically used to satisfy thirst.
venomgland: The venom gland is a crafting material, that is dropped by a number of Enemies.
wooddiggingtool: The Wooden digging tool is a mining Tool.
woodtrowel: The Wooden trowel is a mining Tool.
woodshovel: The Wooden shovel is a mining Tool.
woodpitchfork: The Wooden pitchfork is a melee Weapon.
woodpickaxe: The Wooden pickaxe is a mining Tool.
woodsickle: The Wooden sickle is a melee Weapon.
wrench: The Wrench is a crafting Tool.
experimentflesh: Yellow flesh is a food item that is mainly obtained from Corpses and slain Traders.
musharm: Wrapvine is an item that is dropped upon breaking Hydreeds. It can be used as a very weak bandage to stop bleeding.
